final_method_selection.Reason Retained: More reliable semantic handoff without mixing obstacle vocabulary into the target query.

final_method_selection.Alternatives Evaluated: rectangular ROI; SAM mask; confidence/layer-qualified mask
final_method_selection.Evidence: median depth std 57.8 -> 30.2 -> 7.0 mm; 111/152 schema-2 frames contained multiple candidate depth layers
final_method_selection.Reason Retained: Prevents background/secondary layers from directly driving tracking, coverage, and reconstruction.

final_method_selection.Best Performing Tested Approach: near-static Kalman estimate with innovation gating
final_method_selection.Evidence: Characterization tests reject corrupted updates and bound prediction-only operation; no continuous empirical trace.
final_method_selection.Reason Retained: Fail-closed continuity contract, but quantitative physical tracking superiority remains unproven.

final_method_selection.Best Performing Tested Approach: ray_nbv in the selected matched development comparison
final_method_selection.Evaluation Metric: measured voxels, novel gain, angular diversity, redundancy
final_method_selection.Evidence: 164 vs 111 covered voxels; 72.6 vs 60.0 deg azimuth span
final_method_selection.Reason Retained: Supports full-sphere directions, bounded standoff, size-aware envelopes, and capability prequalification.

final_method_selection.Alternatives Evaluated: workspace-only; capability atlas; exact Tesseract checks
final_method_selection.Best Performing Tested Approach: 2M-sample atlas as coarse gate, Tesseract as exact authority
final_method_selection.Evidence: 100%% final-support recall; 0.280 ms median query; initial full-sphere survival 263/2520 rays across seven pools.
final_method_selection.Reason Retained: Reduces expensive attempts without treating coarse support as collision/path proof.

final_method_selection.Alternatives Evaluated: Tesseract physical integration; cuRobo branch exploration
final_method_selection.Best Performing Tested Approach: Tesseract for the physically validated final system
final_method_selection.Evidence: Controlled replay median wall time 19.646 s Tesseract vs 0.630 s cuRobo; exact-validation pass rate 100.0% for both successful path sets. cuRobo remains hardware_qualified=false.
final_method_selection.Reason Retained: Strongest physically validated integration evidence; no claim of algorithmic superiority.

final_method_selection.Alternatives Evaluated: robot pose; bounded sequential/multiway GICP; constrained superposition; static-scene pose graph
final_method_selection.Best Performing Tested Approach: bounded auto-selection, not one universally fixed mode
final_method_selection.Evidence: Current seven-view replay selected multiway GICP, but every mode remained FAIL against 35 mm dimensions.
final_method_selection.Reason Retained: Permits bounded residual correction while preserving the robot-pose baseline and failing closed.
